en-US.description: Upload a model photo and change the pose with smart, text, or image guidance while keeping face identity and campaign style consistent.
en-US.empty.modelImage: Please upload a model image first
en-US.error.noModels: No AI model is currently available
en-US.error.noSize: The current model does not provide a usable size preset
en-US.error.poseReferenceRequired: Please upload at least 1 pose reference image
en-US.error.referenceLimit: The reference image limit for the current model has been reached
en-US.error.references: The uploaded images do not contain usable reference identifiers
en-US.generationMode.advanced.desc: Enhances limb transitions, weight balance, hand and foot naturalness, and realistic garment folds for the new pose.
en-US.generationMode.standard.desc: Stable pose changes with consistent face identity and commercially usable results.
en-US.label: Model Pose Swap
en-US.placeholder.posePrompt: Adjust the model in the image to a more creative and fashion-forward pose.
en-US.poseMode.image.desc: Upload one or more pose reference images and reuse their body arrangement.
en-US.poseMode.smart.desc: Upload only the model photo and let AI infer a natural, commercially usable pose automatically.
en-US.poseMode.text.desc: Describe the target pose in text for quick creative exploration.
en-US.upload.modelImage.help: Use a clear single-person model photo. Face, outfit, and scene should be easy to preserve.
en-US.upload.poseReferenceImages.help: Upload one or more pose reference images. Only the pose is reused — not the face, clothing, or background. Multi-image generation assigns one pose reference to each output in order; when outputs exceed pose references, the pose references are reused cyclically.

zh-CN.description: 上传真人模特图，通过智能、文字或以图换姿生成人脸一致、风格统一的模特组图。
zh-CN.error.noModels: 暂无可用 AI 模型
zh-CN.error.noSize: 当前模型缺少可用尺寸配置
zh-CN.error.poseReferenceRequired: 请上传至少 1 张姿势参考图
zh-CN.error.referenceLimit: 参考图数量已达当前模型上限
zh-CN.error.references: 图片缺少可用于生成的资源标识
zh-CN.generationMode.advanced.desc: 增强肢体过渡、重心平衡、手脚自然度，以及新姿态下服饰的合理褶皱变化。
zh-CN.generationMode.standard.desc: 强调稳定换姿、身份一致，适合常规商拍生成。
zh-CN.label: 模特换姿势
zh-CN.placeholder.posePrompt: 将图中模特调整为一个更具创意和时尚感的姿势。
zh-CN.poseMode.image.desc: 上传一张或多张姿势参考图，复用其肢体摆放与姿态结构。
zh-CN.poseMode.smart.desc: 只需上传模特图，由 AI 自动推断更自然、商拍可用的姿势，无需额外参考。
zh-CN.poseMode.text.desc: 用文字描述目标姿势，适合快速尝试不同创意姿态。
zh-CN.toast.success: 模特换姿势图生成成功！
zh-CN.upload.modelImage.help: 建议上传清晰的单人模特图，便于保持人脸、服饰与场景一致。
zh-CN.upload.poseReferenceImages.help: 支持上传多张姿势参考图，只会复用姿态，不会复制脸、衣服或背景。多图生成时会按顺序为每张结果分配 1 张姿势参考图；当生成张数多于参考图数量时，会循环复用姿势参考图。
